wizard.title: Setup wizard
wizard.welcomeBody: This wizard walks you through the most important settings in a few steps: Steam, Battle.net, and notifications. Everything is optional and you can cancel at any time.
wizard.welcomeHint: Nothing here is required — skip whatever you don't need and set it up later in Settings.
wizard.steamBody: Enter your Steam Web API key and SteamID64 to select your game library for pre-caching. You can add both later in Settings too.
wizard.battlenetBody: The Battle.net product selection has its own page with every available title. Open it to make your picks.
wizard.notificationsBody: Optional: enter a Discord webhook URL to get notified about finished downloads and warnings. More channels (ntfy, web push) are available in Settings.
wizard.doneBody: You can make further changes in Settings at any time.

login.title: CachePanel
login.totpHint: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code.
dashboard.clearCacheConfirm: Really clear the ENTIRE cache? This affects every service (Steam, Battle.net, Epic, ...), not just one -- a targeted partial clear isn't technically safe. Already-cached downloads would need to be pulled from the internet again afterwards.
setup.restoreHint: Or restore an existing backup file to recover accounts and settings from a lost ./data directory.
settings.steamLoginSuccess: Signed in with Steam — SteamID64 was filled in automatically.
settings.steamLoginFailed: Steam sign-in failed, please try again.
settings.steamLoginHint: Fills in your SteamID64 automatically — you'll still need to enter the API key separately (Steam doesn't hand that out via login).
settings.steamApiKeyHintSuffix: — the domain name doesn't matter, e.g. enter “localhost”.
settings.steamId64HintPrefix: Your 17-digit user ID, look it up e.g. via
settings.importedNotice: Selection imported. Individual pages reload next time they're opened.
settings.exportImportHint: Backs up your current Steam/Battle.net/Epic selection as a file, or restores a previously exported file (e.g. for another CachePanel instance).
settings.usersHint: Other people can sign in with their own account. At least one account always remains.
settings.twoFactorHint: Adds a code from an authenticator app on top of your own login.
settings.twoFactorSecretHint: Enter manually in your authenticator app (secret or link):
settings.heartbeatHint: Periodically pings an external URL (e.g. Healthchecks.io or an Uptime Kuma push monitor) so you're notified if CachePanel itself goes down.
settings.ntfyHint: Additional notification channel alongside Discord -- uses the public ntfy.sh service or a self-hosted instance.
settings.webpushHint: Direct browser notifications for this device — independent of Discord/ntfy. Each device has to opt in separately.
settings.webpushUnsupported: Your browser doesn't support web push notifications.
settings.steamgriddbHintPrefix: Optional — with a free API key from
settings.steamgriddbHintSuffix: the Steam and Battle.net lists show cover art.
settings.discordWebhookHintPrefix: Optional — instructions for creating a webhook in the
settings.discordTestSentNotice: Test message sent — check your Discord channel.
settings.discordTestFailed: Could not send the test message.
settings.discordNotifyDiskWarning: Notify on cache disk warning (90%+ full)
settings.reportHint: Sends a weekly summary (requests, hit ratio, bandwidth saved, disk usage) to the webhook configured above.
settings.runHistoryLimitHint: How many entries to keep in the run history (10-500). A lower value only takes effect gradually on future runs, not retroactively.
settings.backupHint: Bundles settings, schedule, run history, and the panel login into one file (not the Steam/Battle.net/Epic selection -- that has its own export above). Settings stay encrypted and only restore on this same server -- moving to a new host means re-entering your Steam key etc. Still treat the file as sensitive.
settings.publicDisplayHint: Shows a login-free, TV/projector-friendly live view (hit ratio, bandwidth saved, traffic timeline) at /display. Contains no credentials, client IPs, or admin functions -- off by default.
settings.publicDisplayPartyNameHint: Shown at the top of the public display. Leave blank for the default "CachePanel" title.
settings.autoBackupHint: Automatically creates a full backup on a schedule in the server's data directory (/data/backups), keeping the newest files up to the retention limit.
settings.autoBackupRetentionHint: How many of the newest automatic backups to keep before older ones are deleted.
settings.autoCleanupEnabled: Automatically clean up corrupted cache files
settings.autoCleanupHint: Periodically checks for 0-byte files (same detection as the manual scan on the dashboard) and removes them automatically as soon as any are found. Off by default.
settings.trafficAlertHint: Notifies once a single service has transferred more than this amount in roughly the last 24h. 0 = disabled.
settings.apiTokensHint: Read-only access for third-party systems (e.g. Home Assistant, your own scripts) via a Bearer token instead of a panel login. The token is only ever shown once, right after creation.
settings.apiTokensCreatedNotice: Token created. Copy it now -- it won't be shown again.
settings.apiTokensNeverShownAgain: Never shown again -- save it somewhere safe now.
settings.apiTokensDeleteConfirm: Really revoke this token? Connected integrations lose access immediately.
schedule.legacyWarning: The old fixed schedule (02:00/23:00) inside the individual prefill containers is still running in parallel until it's manually disabled.
trafficChart.empty: No activity recorded yet for a timeline.
